title: Learning to write words!
summary: Practise joining letters and syllables to write Spanish words.
keyIdeas: We combine letters to write words and represent their sounds.
Checking our writing helps us improve.

basicKnowledge: D. Reflexión sobre la lengua y sus usos en el marco de propuestas la producción y comprensión de textos orales, escritos o multimodales

activities.prompt: In the Spanish sentence «El perro corre», the words are correctly spaced.
activities.explanation: We leave a space between words when writing.

activities.prompt: Join the syllables to form these Spanish words: «casa», «pelo» and «luna».
activities.explanation: Ca + sa makes casa; pe + lo makes pelo; and lu + na makes luna.

activities.prompt: Choose the correctly spelt Spanish word to complete the sentence.
activities.explanation: Lápiz starts with l and ends with z. It also has an accent on a.
activities.hint: We use it to draw and write.
activities.sentence: Hugo dibuja en su cuaderno con un ___.

activities.prompt: Put the letters in order to write an animal's name in Spanish.
Which Spanish word is correctly spelt?
activities.explanation: Barco starts with b and has an r in the middle.

activities.prompt: Sort these Spanish words by their syllables.
activities.explanation: Pan and sol each have one syllable. Me-sa and mo-no each have two.

activities.prompt: Aisha checks her notebook. Which Spanish word has a spelling mistake?
activities.explanation: Kasa is misspelt. In Spanish, casa starts with c.

activities.prompt: Read the Spanish text carefully and answer the questions.
activities.explanation: Martina uses short, clear words to send a message to her grandfather.
activities.title: La nota de Martina
activities.text: Martina escribe una nota para su abuelo. En el papel pone: «Hola, te quiero mucho. Hoy comí sopa de fideos». Martina firma su nota con una carita feliz.

questions.prompt: Who is Martina writing the note for?
questions.explanation: The text says Martina writes to her grandfather.

questions.prompt: Which Spanish word in the text names a food?

activities.prompt: Order the Spanish sentence: first the animal, then what it does, then what it eats.
activities.explanation: First name the animal, El león, then its action, come carne.
